description: Page reader: one URL to clean markdown (or text) with title, description, author, date and links. Price: $0.005 USDC per call on Base, paid with x402; not charged if the call fails.

format.description: markdown (default) keeps headings, links, lists, tables and code; text strips them

links.description: Return the links found in the content (default true)

url.description: Page to read, e.g. https://example.com/blog/post. Public http(s) URLs only; static HTML (no JavaScript rendering)

name: read
